title: Webhook API
body: pretix should be able to send webhooks to external services e.g. on new orders or payment events.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: This could also live in a plugin completely :)

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: +1 -> This would allow to integrate Pretix into RocketChat very easily: RocketChat has incoming webhooks, so many other people can become independent from slack and still use pretix: https://rocket.chat/docs/administrator-guides/integrations/

comments.author: Participant 2
